item.title: CKUT is Hiring: Volunteer Coordinator
item.description: Love radio, music, and the power of community? Most of all – do you love people? Come join our team as the next Volunteer Coordinator!

item.title: Trying to Listen to CKUT on a Radio App?
item.description: We've tested a bunch of apps... some are playing the wrong CKUT feed (we're working on it...), some have really obnoxious ads, but we found one that we can recommend. Ps. we are working on building our own...

item.title: CKUT is Hiring: Music Librarian
item.description: Love radio, local music, and organizing things? Come join us as the station's next Music Librarian.

item.title: CKUT opens its doors for World College Radio Day
item.description: Have you ever wanted to be on the radio? October 4 is your day. In celebration of World College Radio Day, CKUT is throwing open the doors of the station from 12-5pm on Friday October 4, 2024 and welcoming YOU to join us.

item.title: SAVE THE DATE – CKUT Annual General Meeting 2024
item.description: SAVE THE DATE-- CKUT's 2024 Annual General Meeting (AGM) will take place on Monday, November 25th, 2024 from 6-8pm on Zoom. Stay tuned for details about how to register to attend.

item.title: “International Radio Report” featured on Radio World!
item.description: One of CKUT's OG shows got a nice little profile on Radio World!

item.title: Get Involved with CKUT’s Station Governance
item.description: CKUT's annual general meeting is coming up and that means we are recruiting for new people to join our station governance teams. This is an opportunity for you to have a say in how the station is managed, and what we sound like.

item.title: Sounds & Pressure NFB Collab – Photo Roundup
item.description: On February 7, 2025 CKUT, the NFB, and the Afrosonic Innovation Lab collaborated on an event to launch a new documentary about Reggae in Canada.

item.title: Elliot Family Production Internship 2026-2027
item.description: CKUT is hiring a production department intern - we're looking for someone who has some experience with hands-on audio projects and is looking to learn more about the field and get involved in community radio.

item.title: CKUT is Seeking a Journalist
item.description: CKUT is seeking an early-career journalist to produce original civic reporting on under-covered issues and underrepresented communities in Montreal. This is a one-year position funded through the Changing Narratives Fund (CNF), pending funding confirmation.
